import ast, json, pathlib, hashlib
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
path = root/'images/runtime/integration_checks/native.py'
source = path.read_bytes()
tree = ast.parse(source)
def membership(script):
    suites = None
    applied = []
    stopped = None
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'SUITES' for t in node.targets):
            suites = ast.literal_eval(node.value)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.Expr) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Call):
            call = node.value
            if isinstance(call.func, ast.Attribute) and call.func.attr == 'append' and isinstance(call.func.value, ast.Subscript) and isinstance(call.func.value.value, ast.Name) and call.func.value.value.id == 'SUITES':
                key = ast.literal_eval(call.func.value.slice)
                value = ast.literal_eval(call.args[0])
                suites[key].append(value)
                applied.append({'line':node.lineno,'module':value})
        elif isinstance(node, ast.If) and ast.unparse(node.test) == "__name__ == '__main__'":
            assert len(node.body) == 1 and isinstance(node.body[0], ast.Raise)
            raised = node.body[0].exc
            assert isinstance(raised, ast.Call) and isinstance(raised.func, ast.Name) and raised.func.id == 'SystemExit'
            assert len(raised.args)==1 and isinstance(raised.args[0],ast.Call) and isinstance(raised.args[0].func,ast.Name) and raised.args[0].func.id=='main'
            if script:
                stopped = node.lineno
                break
    return {'suites':suites,'applied':applied,'exit_guard_line':stopped}
cli, imported = membership(True), membership(False)
name = 'test_adaptive_acquisition_aggregate_cost'
assert name not in cli['suites']['protocol']
assert imported['suites']['protocol'].count(name)==1
assert imported['suites']['protocol'][:-1]==cli['suites']['protocol']
result = {'source_bytes':len(source),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),'cli':cli,'imported':imported,'verdict':'NEW_AGGREGATE_TEST_UNREACHABLE_IN_SCRIPT_ENTRYPOINT','scope':'Independent literal AST prefix interpreter; does not execute submitted native runner or its tests. Normal-return main raises SystemExit before the append; main exception also cannot reach append.'}
(root/'CATALOGUE_COUNTEREXAMPLE.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'verdict':result['verdict'],'cli_protocol_modules':len(cli['suites']['protocol']),'import_protocol_modules':len(imported['suites']['protocol']),'exit_guard_line':cli['exit_guard_line'],'new_append_line':imported['applied'][-1]['line']}))
